posts.title: Kiro for Test-Driven Development (TDD)
posts.description: This post explores the compatibility of Test-Driven Development (TDD) with AI coding assistants, specifically using Kiro, an AI-powered IDE. The author conducts an experiment involving the Number Parser Kata to demonstrate how Kiro effectively follows TDD principles, emphasizing that TDD remains essential for ensuring that AI-generated code solves the intended problems accurately.
